product_one_liner.value: Incorta gives data and AI teams a governed platform connecting live operational data to analytics, AI agents, applications, and workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes the governed platform and connected workloads; the demo page identifies data and AI teams as users. Sources: https://www.incorta.com/ and https://www.incorta.com/demo

pricing_page.notes: Incorta has a public Microsoft Marketplace Plans + Pricing page describing its Workbench for Workday plan and prices. This is marketplace-hosted pricing rather than an incorta.com pricing page. Source: https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/apps/incorta.incorta_direct_data_platform?tab=PlansAndPrice

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Incorta's customer logo area explicitly names Starbucks and Comcast under 'Trusted by data & AI teams at'. Source: https://www.incorta.com/demo | named_customers.0: Starbucks appears in the customer trust area at https://www.incorta.com/demo. | named_customers.1: Comcast appears in the customer trust area at https://www.incorta.com/demo.

employee_band.notes: The company profile evidence reports 328 LinkedIn-associated employees and a company-size band of 201–500. The band is explicit, although LinkedIn-associated headcount is not audited staffing. Source associated with the profile: https://www.incorta.com/

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The contact page explicitly labels its Foster City address as Main Headquarters. Source: https://www.incorta.com/contact | hq_country: The main headquarters address is Foster City, California 94404, placing it in the United States. Source: https://www.incorta.com/contact

founded_year.notes: Incorta explicitly states that it was founded in 2014. Its separate history of prototypes beginning in 2013 is not an explicit founding date. Source: https://www.incorta.com/press-releases/incorta-raises-120m-in-series-d-funding-amid-soaring-global-demand-for-unified-data-analytics

eng_blog.notes: Only one qualifying engineer-written product-build article was established: the star-schema architecture article. The publication index did not expose a second qualifying post; the other implementation case study located was authored by a UX designer. False applies the requested two-post threshold, but index visibility makes this conclusion uncertain. Sources: https://medium.com/engineering-incorta and https://medium.com/engineering-incorta/incorta-bringing-agility-to-the-star-schema-world-b0447f13a127

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal provides guides, references, and release documentation for Incorta Cloud and on-premises products. Source: https://docs.incorta.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists Solution Engineer, Principle Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, and Account Executive. None has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science term in its title; AI-related duties in software-engineering descriptions do not satisfy the title-only rule. Source: https://jobs.lever.co/incorta

model_provider.notes: The homepage names Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI. The AI Gateway engineering posting explicitly names Anthropic and OpenAI APIs used in its data plane. Sources: https://www.incorta.com/ and https://jobs.lever.co/incorta/dc034adb-5dab-48cc-9c75-3433ddf5b2d6

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page identifies an available SOC 2 Type II report and claims GDPR compliance. GDPR is included as a requested compliance claim, not characterized as an independently issued certification. Source: http://incorta.com/platform/security | compliance_certs.0: An available SOC 2 Type II report is explicitly claimed at http://incorta.com/platform/security. | compliance_certs.1: GDPR compliance is explicitly named at http://incorta.com/platform/security.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Including debt financing, the latest recorded round is Conventional Debt on June 24, 2021. The separately announced $120 million Series D occurred the previous day and is not used as the amount of this debt transaction. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/incorta/__ix_-YAO-d2ich_O5OQ4_fDOT3p40QwIVJyRk0C6ZgQE/funding-and-investors | funding_date: The latest recorded financing is dated June 24, 2021, yielding 2021-06. This includes debt financing; the preceding equity round was the June 23, 2021 Series D. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/incorta/__ix_-YAO-d2ich_O5OQ4_fDOT3p40QwIVJyRk0C6ZgQE/funding-and-investors | funding_amount_usd: The latest financing record is conventional debt dated June 24, 2021, with no disclosed amount in the structured record. Other sources inconsistently attribute amounts between debt and the preceding Series D, so the debt amount is not reliably confirmed. Public funding profile: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/incorta/__ix_-YAO-d2ich_O5OQ4_fDOT3p40QwIVJyRk0C6ZgQE/funding-and-investors

raised_18mo.notes: The funding history's newest transaction is June 2021, before the May 2025 start of the 18-month window. No later round appears in the funding history reviewed. Source: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/incorta/__ix_-YAO-d2ich_O5OQ4_fDOT3p40QwIVJyRk0C6ZgQE/funding-and-investors

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive opening has a live application page and is listed on the current job board. Sources: https://jobs.lever.co/incorta/8a6bbe3c-187c-40bc-976c-a53caec34a73 and https://jobs.lever.co/incorta

launched_6mo.notes: On September 30, 2026, Incorta announced Analyst Studio, adding governed data transformation for analyst and agent-driven workflows. This substantive feature launch falls within the six-month window. Source: https://www.incorta.com/press-releases/incorta-adds-governed-data-transformation-for-agentic-workflows-with-incorta-intelligence

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Omar Hajsaleh's profile dates his Incorta Vice President of Sales EMEA role to December 2025, following AWS. This is a new-company join within the requested 12-month window. The evidence is a self-reported career profile rather than a company announcement. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/omar-hajsaleh

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The SDR posting instructs employees to manage prospect interactions in Salesforce and Outreach, providing an operational-use signal rather than merely listing compatible integrations. Source: https://jobs.lever.co/incorta/296a367c-e2b9-4d27-976b-805b5e8ecd31 | crm_stack_signal.0: The SDR posting explicitly instructs employees to use Salesforce: https://jobs.lever.co/incorta/296a367c-e2b9-4d27-976b-805b5e8ecd31. | crm_stack_signal.1: The SDR posting explicitly instructs employees to use Outreach: https://jobs.lever.co/incorta/296a367c-e2b9-4d27-976b-805b5e8ecd31.
